note: Curated metadata for the checkpoints TensorFold serves. Sizes are refreshed from Hugging Face when online; bytes_per_token values are estimates used for the context estimate. bytes_per_token for Gemma 4, Qwen3.8-27B and Bonsai 2 are the engine's own startup figures on a Mac mini M6 (TensorFold 0.6.5). workspace_bytes covers what the engine keeps beyond the files (fused projections, an MTP head) plus its prompt and draft work; the 27B's and Bonsai's values reproduce the context the engine admitted on that Mac. Tags describe what TensorFold can serve from the checkpoint here, not the vendor's model card: 'vision' means TensorFold's --vision path reads images for this family. The oQ entries are mixed-width checkpoints: `native_from` names the first native release that serves them, as `capabilities --json` lists uniform formats only; their bytes_per_token and workspace_bytes are the 4-bit 27B's until measured.

models.name: Gemma 4 26B-A4B
models.description: Great all-rounder. A mixture of experts with 3.8B active parameters, so it is quick.

models.name: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B
models.description: The fastest model here, strong at code edits. Ships its own draft head.

models.name: Ternary Bonsai 2 27B
models.description: Qwen3.8-27B's knowledge retrained to 2-bit weights: 8 GB on disk, 12 GiB resident with its drafter, 61k tokens of context on a 32 GB Mac.

models.name: Qwen3.8-27B
models.description: The best quality that fits a 32 GB Mac, with z-lab's draft model for speed. Reads images.

models.name: Qwen3.8-27B
models.description: Qwen3.8-27B in mixed 4- to 6-bit widths (oMLX's oQ4): close to the 4-bit model, a little larger. Native on Macs from TensorFold 1.0.10, with the DFlash2 drafter.

models.name: Qwen3.8-27B
models.description: Qwen3.8-27B in mixed 2- to 8-bit widths (oMLX's oQ2): 11 GB on disk, so a 32 GB Mac keeps more room for context, at some cost in quality. Native on Macs from TensorFold 1.0.10, with the DFlash2 drafter.

models.name: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B
models.description: A fast mixture of experts with its own draft head.

models.name: Qwen3.8 Flash Next
models.description: The large one: 125B parameters, 6B active, 1M context, reads images. For 128 GB machines and DGX Sparks.

models.name: GLM-5.3-Flash
models.description: 320B parameters, 18B active, 1M context, reads images. For a 256 GB Mac or two DGX Sparks.

models.name: DeepSeek-V4-Flash
models.description: 284B parameters, 13B active, 1M context. For a 256 GB Mac.
